import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']

# Aggregate yellowtail by day of year across all seasons
# Filter for complete data (yt kept+released per trip)
doy_stats = trips.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

# Calculate yt per angler
doy_stats['yt_per_angler'] = doy_stats['yt'] / doy_stats['anglers'].replace(0, 1)

# Show peak windows (doy 80-160 = April-June, doy 280-310 = October)
april_june = doy_stats[(doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] >= 80) & (doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 160)].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False).head(10)
october = doy_stats[(doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] >= 280) & (doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 310)].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False).head(10)

print("=== APRIL-JUNE PEAK (doy 80-160) ===")
print(april_june[['fished_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']])
print("\n=== OCTOBER PEAK (doy 280-310) ===")
print(october[['fished_date_doy', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']])

# What's my score target? Season average
print("\n=== SEASON 2 FLEET AVERAGE ===")
result = doy_stats[doy_stats['fished_date_doy'] <= 213].agg({'yt': 'mean', 'anglers': 'mean', 'yt_per_angler': 'mean'})
print(result)
